availability_source: JustWatch US (apis.justwatch.com), subscription (flatrate) offers only. All rows re-verified 2026-10-30 (includes HIDIVE)

items.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
items.why: Next after Goblet of Fire (9): Umbridge takes over Hogwarts and Dumbledore's Army fights back. The series turns darker and bigger.
items.synopsis: Returning for his fifth year at Hogwarts, Harry is stunned to find that his warnings about the return of Lord Voldemort have been ignored. Left with no choice, Harry takes matters into his own hands, training a small group of motivated students to defend themselves against the Dark Arts.

items.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
items.why: Next after Rise (9), Dawn (9) and War (8): generations after Caesar, a young ape faces a tyrant building his own empire.
items.synopsis: Several generations following Caesar's reign, apes – now the dominant species – live harmoniously while humans have been reduced to living in the shadows. As a new tyrannical ape leader builds his empire, one young ape undertakes a harrowing journey that will cause him to question all he's known about the past and to make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike.

items.title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
items.why: Next after An Unexpected Journey (10): Bilbo and the dwarves reach Smaug's mountain. The barrel chase and the dragon are highlights.
items.synopsis: The Dwarves, Bilbo and Gandalf have successfully escaped the Misty Mountains, and Bilbo has gained the One Ring. They all continue their journey to get their gold back from the Dragon, Smaug.

items.title: Gladiator II
items.why: The sequel to Gladiator (9.5): Lucius fights his way through the Colosseum decades later. Big arena spectacle from Ridley Scott.
items.synopsis: After his home is conquered by the tyrannical emperors who now lead Rome, Lucius is forced to enter the Colosseum and must look to his past to find strength to return the glory of Rome to its people.

items.title: The Thing
items.why: Carpenter's Antarctic shapeshifter siege. Paranoia, practical effects, and the blood-test scene; peak creature horror.
items.synopsis: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.

items.title: Inglourious Basterds
items.why: Tarantino's WWII revenge fantasy: Jewish-American commandos and a cinema owner plot to kill the Nazi high command. Pulp Fiction (9) energy.
items.synopsis: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a group of Jewish-American soldiers known as "The Basterds" are chosen specifically to spread fear throughout the Third Reich by scalping and brutally killing Nazis. The Basterds, lead by Lt. Aldo Raine soon cross paths with a French-Jewish teenage girl who runs a movie theater in Paris which is targeted by the soldiers.

items.title: RRR
items.why: Explore pick: two revolutionaries in 1920s India in a maximalist Telugu action epic. The bridge rescue and the animal ambush are unforgettable.
items.synopsis: A fictional history of two legendary revolutionaries' journey away from home before they began fighting for their country in the 1920s.

items.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
items.why: Next after Mockingjay Part 1 (8): Katniss leads the assault on the Capitol. The finale of the original four.
items.synopsis: As the war between the Capitol and the districts reaches its peak, Katniss Everdeen embarks on a perilous mission to liberate Panem and confront President Snow. Joined by a team of trusted allies, she navigates deadly traps, shifting loyalties, and the heavy cost of rebellion, determined to bring freedom to her people and end the Hunger Games once and for all.

items.title: Memento
items.why: Nolan's backwards-told revenge mystery about a man with no short-term memory. Inception (10) and The Prestige (9) DNA.
items.synopsis: Leonard Shelby is tracking down the man who raped and murdered his wife. The difficulty of locating his wife's killer, however, is compounded by the fact that he suffers from a rare, untreatable form of short-term memory loss. Although he can recall details of life before his accident, Leonard cannot remember what happened fifteen minutes ago, where he's going, or why.

items.title: Godzilla Minus One
items.why: Post-war Japan faces Godzilla with no army left. Oscar-winning effects and a surprisingly moving story; a fresh standalone take.
items.synopsis: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

items.title: Extraction
items.why: A mercenary (Chris Hemsworth) extracts a kidnapped boy in Dhaka. Famous for its 12-minute one-take chase.
items.synopsis: Tyler Rake, a fearless black market mercenary, embarks on the most deadly extraction of his career when he's enlisted to rescue the kidnapped son of an imprisoned international crime lord.

items.title: The Usual Suspects
items.why: Five crooks, one lineup, and the legend of Keyser Söze. Twisty crime puzzle with one of the great endings.
items.synopsis: The lone survivor of an explosive heist gone wrong recounts for interrogators the events that began with five disparate criminals assembled for a police lineup - with alleged criminal mastermind Keyser Soze at the center of it all.

items.title: Final Destination 3
items.why: Next after Final Destination 2 (8): a rollercoaster premonition sets Death's list in motion again. More inventive kills.
items.synopsis: High school senior Wendy's premonition of a deadly rollercoaster ride saves her life and a lucky few, but not from death itself — which seeks out those who escaped their fate.

items.title: Spirited Away
items.why: Explore pick: a girl trapped in a spirit bathhouse must save her parents. Miyazaki's Oscar winner; fantasy adventure at its most imaginative.
items.synopsis: A young girl, Chihiro, becomes trapped in a strange new world of spirits. When her parents undergo a mysterious transformation, she must call upon the courage she never knew she had to free her family.

items.title: Hell or High Water
items.why: Two brothers rob banks across West Texas while Jeff Bridges's ranger closes in. Lean, modern crime western.
items.synopsis: A divorced dad and his ex-con brother resort to a desperate scheme in order to save their family's farm in West Texas.

items.title: The Black Phone
items.why: A kidnapped boy gets calls from the killer's past victims on a dead phone. Tight, crowd-pleasing horror with Ethan Hawke.
items.synopsis: Finney Blake, a shy but clever 13-year-old boy, is abducted by a sadistic killer and trapped in a soundproof basement where screaming is of little use. When a disconnected phone on the wall begins to ring, Finney discovers that he can hear the voices of the killer’s previous victims. And they are dead set on making sure that what happened to them doesn’t happen to Finney.

items.title: Point Break
items.why: An FBI rookie goes undercover with bank-robbing surfers led by Patrick Swayze. Kathryn Bigelow's adrenaline classic.
items.synopsis: In Los Angeles, a gang of bank robbers who call themselves The Ex-Presidents commit their crimes while wearing masks of Reagan, Carter, Nixon and Johnson. Believing that the members of the gang could be surfers, the F.B.I. sends young agent Johnny Utah to the beach undercover to mix with the surfers and gather information.

items.title: The Tomorrow War
items.why: Soldiers from 2051 draft present-day people to fight an alien war. Big, propulsive Chris Pratt sci-fi action.
items.synopsis: The world is stunned when a group of time travelers arrive from the year 2051 to deliver an urgent message: Thirty years in the future, mankind is losing a global war against a deadly alien species. The only hope for survival is for soldiers and civilians from the present to be transported to the future and join the fight. Among those recruited is high school teacher and family man Dan Forester. Determined to save the world for his young daughter, Dan teams up with a brilliant scientist and his estranged father in a desperate quest to rewrite the fate of the planet.

items.title: The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It
items.why: Next after The Conjuring 2 (7.5): the Warrens take on a murder case with a demonic-possession defense.
items.synopsis: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren encounter what would become one of the most sensational cases from their files. The fight for the soul of a young boy takes them beyond anything they'd ever seen before, to mark the first time in U.S. history that a murder suspect would claim demonic possession as a defense.

items.title: The Gentlemen
items.why: Guy Ritchie's crime caper about an American selling his London weed empire. Fast, funny, and twisty; Snatch-style swagger.
items.synopsis: American expat Mickey Pearson has built a highly profitable marijuana empire in London. When word gets out that he’s looking to cash out of the business forever it triggers plots, schemes, bribery and blackmail in an attempt to steal his domain out from under him.

items.title: The Killer
items.why: Fincher's cold, methodical hitman (Michael Fassbender) goes on a revenge tour after a job goes wrong.
items.synopsis: After a fateful miss, an assassin battles his employers, and himself, on an international manhunt he insists isn't personal.

items.title: Akira
items.why: Explore pick: biker gangs and psychic power tear apart Neo-Tokyo. The landmark 1988 anime film; huge influence on modern sci-fi.
items.synopsis: A secret military project endangers Neo-Tokyo when it turns a biker gang member into a rampaging psychic psychopath that only two teenagers and a group of psychics can stop.

items.title: Triple Frontier
items.why: Ex-special forces friends rob a South American drug lord, and the escape becomes the real fight. Grounded heist-action.
items.synopsis: Struggling to make ends meet, former special ops soldiers reunite for a high-stakes heist: stealing $75 million from a South American drug lord.

items.title: Heretic
items.why: Two missionaries knock on Hugh Grant's door and can't leave. A sharp, talky trap thriller that turns nasty.
items.synopsis: Two young Mormon women are drawn into a game of cat-and-mouse in the house of a strange man.

items.title: Reservoir Dogs
items.why: Tarantino's debut: a jewelry heist gone wrong and the rat in the warehouse. Pure crime tension.
items.synopsis: A botched robbery indicates a police informant, and the pressure mounts in the aftermath at a warehouse. Crime begets violence as the survivors -- veteran Mr. White, newcomer Mr. Orange, psychopathic parolee Mr. Blonde, bickering weasel Mr. Pink and Nice Guy Eddie -- unravel.

items.title: The Handmaiden
items.why: Explore pick: Park Chan-wook's con-artist thriller in 1930s Korea. Twists every act; stylish and adult.
items.synopsis: 1930s Korea, in the period of Japanese occupation, a new girl, Sook-hee, is hired as a handmaiden to a Japanese heiress, Hideko, who lives a secluded life on a large countryside estate with her domineering Uncle Kouzuki. But the maid has a secret. She is a pickpocket recruited by a swindler posing as a Japanese Count to help him seduce the Lady to steal her fortune.

items.title: The Old Guard 2
items.why: Next after The Old Guard (7.5): Andy's immortal mercenaries face an even older immortal.
items.synopsis: Andy leads immortal warriors against a powerful enemy threatening their group. They grapple with the resurfacing of a long-lost immortal, complicating their mission to safeguard humanity.

items.title: Wind River
items.why: A tracker and an FBI agent investigate a murder on a Wyoming reservation. Taylor Sheridan's tense snowbound thriller (Sicario writer).
items.synopsis: An FBI agent teams with the town's veteran game tracker to investigate a murder that occurred on a Native American reservation.

items.title: It Follows
items.why: A curse that walks toward you, slowly, forever. One of the best high-concept horror premises of the 2010s.
items.synopsis: A young woman is followed by an unknown supernatural force after a sexual encounter.

items.title: Rashomon
items.why: Explore pick: Kurosawa's crime told from four conflicting points of view. The film that invented the unreliable-witness mystery.
items.synopsis: Four people recount different versions of the story of a man's murder and the rape of his wife.

items.title: Crime 101
items.why: A jewel thief working the 101 freeway, a detective closing in, and an insurance broker caught between them. 2026 crime thriller.
items.synopsis: When an elusive thief whose high-stakes heists unfold along the iconic 101 freeway in Los Angeles eyes the score of a lifetime, with hopes of this being his final job, his path collides with a disillusioned insurance broker who is facing her own crossroads. Determined to crack the case, a relentless detective closes in on the operation, raising the stakes even higher.

items.title: The Platform 2
items.why: Next after The Platform (8): a new pair of prisoners and new rules in the vertical prison.
items.synopsis: A thrilling physical journey that allows an approach to the darkness, where it is scary to look. It appeals to the viewer's civil responsibility and forces them to face the limits of their own solidarity.

items.title: The Northman
items.why: A Viking prince's revenge saga from Robert Eggers. Brutal and mythic, like Braveheart (9) with gods.
items.synopsis: Prince Amleth is on the verge of becoming a man when his father is brutally murdered by his uncle, who kidnaps the boy's mother. Two decades later, Amleth is now a Viking who's on a mission to save his mother, kill his uncle and avenge his father.

items.title: All Quiet on the Western Front
items.why: Explore pick: a German teenager's WWI from the trenches. Oscar-winning war film; harrowing and visually stunning.
items.synopsis: Paul Baumer and his friends Albert and Muller, egged on by romantic dreams of heroism, voluntarily enlist in the German army. Full of excitement and patriotic fervour, the boys enthusiastically march into a war they believe in. But once on the Western Front, they discover the soul-destroying horror of World War I.

items.title: Boss Level
items.why: An ex-soldier relives the day he's assassinated over and over. Edge of Tomorrow (9) loop with Frank Grillo.
items.synopsis: A former special forces agent is trapped in a time loop and relives his death over and over again. To escape the terrible situation, he must track down those responsible and stop them.

items.title: Bring Her Back
items.why: From the Talk to Me directors: two siblings in a foster home with a terrifying ritual. One of 2025's most acclaimed horror films.
items.synopsis: Following the death of their father, a brother and sister are sent to live with a foster mother, only to learn that she is hiding a terrifying secret.

items.why: Two WWI soldiers race across enemy territory to deliver a warning, shot as one continuous take. Tense and immersive.
items.synopsis: At the height of the First World War, two young British soldiers must cross enemy territory and deliver a message that will stop a deadly attack on hundreds of soldiers.

items.title: Lady Snowblood
items.why: Explore pick: a woman born for revenge cuts through 1870s Japan. The bloody inspiration for Kill Bill (9).
items.synopsis: A strikingly beautiful young woman is trained from birth to be a deadly instrument of revenge against the swindlers who destroyed her family.

items.title: The Abyss
items.why: James Cameron's deep-sea rescue crew encounters something non-human. Underwater sci-fi from the Avatar (8) director.
items.synopsis: A civilian oil rig crew is recruited to conduct a search and rescue effort when a nuclear submarine mysteriously sinks. One diver soon finds himself on a spectacular odyssey 25,000 feet below the ocean's surface where he confronts a mysterious force that has the power to change the world or destroy it.

items.title: His House
items.why: Refugees escape South Sudan for a UK council house that won't let them go. Smart, scary, and very fresh horror.
items.synopsis: After making a harrowing escape from war-torn South Sudan, a young refugee couple struggle to adjust to their new life in a small English town that has an unspeakable evil lurking beneath the surface.

items.title: The Beekeeper
items.why: Jason Statham's retired operative takes down a phishing empire. Silly-fun, nonstop action.
items.synopsis: One man's campaign for vengeance takes on national stakes after he is revealed to be a former operative of a powerful and clandestine organization known as Beekeepers.

items.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
items.why: Next X-Men film in release order after The Last Stand (7.5): Logan's origin and Weapon X.
items.synopsis: After seeking to live a normal life after 200 years, Logan sets out to avenge a death by undergoing the mutant Weapon X program and becoming Wolverine.

items.title: Perfect Blue
items.why: Explore pick: Satoshi Kon's psychological thriller about a pop idol turned actress who is being stalked. Reality and paranoia blur.
items.synopsis: Rising pop star Mima Kirigoe quits singing to pursue a career as an actress. After she takes up a role on a popular detective show, her handlers and collaborators begin turning up murdered. Harboring feelings of guilt and haunted by visions of her former self, Mima's reality and fantasy meld into a frenzied paranoia.

items.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
items.why: Next after The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (7.5): the Pevensies return to a conquered Narnia.
items.synopsis: One year after their incredible adventures in the Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe, Peter, Edmund, Lucy and Susan Pevensie return to Narnia to aid a young prince whose life has been threatened by the evil King Miraz. Now, with the help of a colorful cast of new characters, including Trufflehunter the badger and Nikabrik the dwarf, the Pevensie clan embarks on an incredible quest to ensure that Narnia is returned to its rightful heir.

items.title: Fear Street: 1994
items.why: Part one of Netflix's slasher trilogy: teens in cursed Shadyside. Fun, gory, and the start of a series.
items.synopsis: A circle of teenage friends accidentally encounter the ancient evil responsible for a series of brutal murders that have plagued their town for over 300 years. Welcome to Shadyside.

items.title: Lawrence of Arabia
items.why: Explore pick: T.E. Lawrence leads the Arab revolt in WWI. The definitive desert epic; Dune (10) owes it a lot.
items.synopsis: During World War I, English officer Thomas Edward 'T.E.' Lawrence sets out to unite and lead the diverse, often warring, Arab tribes to fight the Turks.

items.title: Princess Mononoke
items.why: Explore pick: a cursed prince caught in a war between forest gods and an iron town. Miyazaki's most action-packed film.
items.synopsis: Ashitaka, a prince of the disappearing Emishi people, is cursed by a demonized boar god and must journey to the west to find a cure. Along the way, he encounters San, a young human woman fighting to protect the forest, and Lady Eboshi, who is trying to destroy it. Ashitaka must find a way to bring balance to this conflict.

items.title: Hit Man
items.why: Glen Powell as a fake hitman for the cops who falls for a client. Twisty Linklater crime comedy, in the vein of Army of Thieves.
items.synopsis: A mild-mannered professor moonlighting as a fake hit man in police stings ignites a chain reaction of trouble when he falls for a potential client.

items.title: Carry-On
items.why: A TSA agent is blackmailed into letting a dangerous bag through on Christmas Eve. Tight one-location action thriller.
items.synopsis: An airport security officer races to outsmart a mysterious traveler forcing him to let a dangerous item slip onto a Christmas Eve flight.

items.title: Anatomy of a Fall
items.why: Explore pick: a Palme d'Or courtroom drama about a writer accused of her husband's death. Gripping and ambiguous, like Rashomon in a modern trial.
items.synopsis: A woman is suspected of her husband's murder, and their blind son faces a moral dilemma as the sole witness.

items.title: Paradise
items.why: Sterling K. Brown's Secret Service agent finds the president dead, and the mystery reveals a hidden world. Sharp sci-fi thriller twists.
items.synopsis: The tranquility in a serene, wealthy community inhabited by some of the world's most prominent individuals explodes when a shocking murder occurs and a high stakes investigation unfolds.

items.title: Peaky Blinders
items.why: The Shelby gang rises in post-WWI Birmingham. Stylish crime saga with Cillian Murphy; Ozark (11) fans tend to love it.
items.synopsis: A gangster family epic set in 1919 Birmingham, England and centered on a gang who sew razor blades in the peaks of their caps, and their fierce boss Tommy Shelby, who means to move up in the world.

items.title: Banshee
items.why: An ex-con assumes the identity of a small-town sheriff. Pulpy, violent, and some of TV's best fight scenes.
items.synopsis: Banshee is an American drama television series set in a small town in Pennsylvania Amish country and features an enigmatic ex-con posing as a murdered sheriff who imposes his own brand of justice while also cooking up plans that serve his own interests.

items.title: Money Heist
items.why: The Professor's crew seizes Spain's Royal Mint. Propulsive heist drama with cliffhangers every episode.
items.synopsis: To carry out the biggest heist in history, a mysterious man called The Professor recruits a band of eight robbers who have a single characteristic: none of them has anything to lose. Five months of seclusion - memorizing every step, every detail, every probability - culminate in eleven days locked up in the National Coinage and Stamp Factory of Spain, surrounded by police forces and with dozens of hostages in their power, to find out whether their suicide wager will lead to everything or nothing.

items.title: The Terminal List
items.why: A Navy SEAL hunts the people behind his team's ambush. Grounded revenge action; Season 2 just arrived Oct 21, 2026.
items.synopsis: A former Navy SEAL officer investigates why his entire platoon was ambushed during a high-stakes covert mission.

items.title: Station Eleven
items.why: A traveling Shakespeare troupe after a flu ends civilization. Prestige post-apocalyptic drama that rewards patience.
items.synopsis: A post apocalyptic saga spanning multiple timelines, telling the stories of survivors of a devastating flu as they attempt to rebuild and reimagine the world anew while holding on to the best of what's been lost.

items.title: Black Doves
items.why: A spy embedded as a politician's wife, plus her hitman friend, in London at Christmas. Season 2 landed Nov 5, 2026.
items.synopsis: When a spy posing as a politician's wife learns her lover has been murdered, an old assassin friend joins her on a quest for truth — and vengeance.

items.title: Narcos
items.why: The DEA hunt for Pablo Escobar. Fast, true-crime-based cartel saga.
items.synopsis: A gritty chronicle of the war against Colombia's infamously violent and powerful drug cartels.

items.why: A migrant ship in 1899 finds a missing vessel, and the mystery spirals. From the creators of Dark (10).
items.synopsis: When mysterious events change the course of an immigrant ship headed for New York in 1899, a mind-bending riddle unfolds for its bewildered passengers.

items.title: Midnight Mass
items.why: Mike Flanagan's island-town miracle turns sinister. From the Usher (8.5) creator; his best.
items.synopsis: An isolated island community experiences miraculous events - and frightening omens - after the arrival of a charismatic, mysterious young priest.

items.title: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan
items.why: Analyst Jack Ryan pulled into field ops (John Krasinski). Clean, propulsive espionage action.
items.synopsis: When CIA analyst Jack Ryan stumbles upon a suspicious series of bank transfers his search for answers pulls him from the safety of his desk job and catapults him into a deadly game of cat and mouse throughout Europe and the Middle East, with a rising terrorist figurehead preparing for a massive attack against the US and her allies.

items.title: The Last Kingdom
items.why: A Saxon-born Dane fights for England's future. Shield-wall battles and politics; Game of Thrones (10) energy with history.
items.synopsis: A show of heroic deeds and epic battles with a thematic depth that embraces politics, religion, warfare, courage, love, loyalty and our universal search for identity. Combining real historical figures and events with fictional characters, it is the story of how a people combined their strength under one of the most iconic kings of history in order to reclaim their land for themselves and build a place they call home.

items.title: Carrie
items.why: Mike Flanagan's 2026 Stephen King adaptation: a bullied girl discovers telekinesis. All eight episodes on Prime.
items.synopsis: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

items.title: Lupin
items.why: A gentleman thief inspired by Arsène Lupin seeks revenge on a wealthy family. Slick heist fun; Part 4 dropped Oct 23, 2026.
items.synopsis: Inspired by the adventures of Arsène Lupin, gentleman thief Assane Diop sets out to avenge his father for an injustice inflicted by a wealthy family.

items.title: The Man in the High Castle
items.why: An alternate America after the Axis won WWII, and films that show another history. High-concept sci-fi thriller.
items.synopsis: Explore what it would be like if the Allied Powers had lost WWII, and Japan and Germany ruled the United States. Based on Philip K. Dick's award-winning novel.

items.title: Black Summer
items.why: Survivors fight through the early days of a zombie outbreak. Breathless and lean; no filler.
items.synopsis: In the dark, early days of a zombie apocalypse, complete strangers band together to find the strength they need to survive and get back to loved ones.

items.title: The Old Man
items.why: Jeff Bridges as a retired CIA operative pulled back in. Tense spy thriller with real action.
items.synopsis: Dan Chase absconded from the CIA decades ago and now lives off the grid. When an assassin arrives and tries to take Chase out, the old operative learns that to ensure his future he now must reconcile his past.

items.title: Killing Eve
items.why: An MI5 agent and a psychopathic assassin become obsessed with each other. Darkly funny spy thriller.
items.synopsis: A security consultant hunts for a ruthless assassin. Equally obsessed with each other, they go head to head in an epic game of cat-and-mouse.

items.title: The Sopranos
items.why: A mob boss in therapy. The show that started TV's golden age; crime drama with dark humor.
items.synopsis: The story of New Jersey-based Italian-American mobster Tony Soprano and the difficulties he faces as he tries to balance the conflicting requirements of his home life and the criminal organization he heads. Those difficulties are often highlighted through his ongoing professional relationship with psychiatrist Jennifer Melfi. The show features Tony's family members and Mafia associates in prominent roles and story arcs, most notably his wife Carmela and his cousin and protégé Christopher Moltisanti.

items.title: All of Us Are Dead
items.why: A zombie outbreak traps students in a Korean high school. Fast, gory survival with clever set pieces.
items.synopsis: A high school becomes ground zero for a zombie virus outbreak. Trapped students must fight their way out — or turn into one of the rabid infected.

items.title: The Wire
items.why: Baltimore's drug war from every side. Widely called the best crime drama ever.
items.synopsis: Told from the points of view of both the Baltimore homicide and narcotics detectives and their targets, the series captures a universe in which the national war on drugs has become a permanent, self-sustaining bureaucracy, and distinctions between good and evil are routinely obliterated.

items.title: Utopia
items.why: A graphic novel that may predict a pandemic, and the conspiracy hunting its fans. Sci-fi thriller on Prime.
items.synopsis: A group of young adults who met online are mercilessly hunted by a shadowy deep state organization after they come into possession of a near-mythical cult underground graphic novel.

items.title: Below
items.why: A 2026 Netflix limited series: a Newfoundland town terrorized by a mysterious creature from the deep. Six episodes.
items.synopsis: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a remote town, a fisherman must fight to protect his family, his community, and his way of life.

items.title: Firefly
items.why: A smuggler crew in a frontier space western. Cult classic; you gave Serenity (8), which comes after it.
items.synopsis: In the year 2517, the universe is a vast frontier where lawlessness reigns and adventure awaits! Join Captain Malcolm Reynolds and his ragtag crew aboard the spaceship Serenity as they navigate the fringes of society, battling the oppressive Alliance and facing off against ruthless bounty hunters.

items.title: Shadow and Bone
items.why: A soldier discovers rare power in a war-torn fantasy world. Includes the Six of Crows heist crew.
items.synopsis: In a world cleaved in two by a massive barrier of perpetual darkness, a young soldier uncovers a power that might finally unite her country. But as she struggles to hone her power, dangerous forces plot against her. Thugs, thieves, assassins and saints are at war now, and it will take more than magic to survive.

items.title: Good Omens
items.why: An angel and a demon team up to stop the apocalypse. Witty Gaiman/Pratchett fantasy.
items.synopsis: Aziraphale and Crowley, of Heaven and Hell respectively, have grown rather fond of the Earth. So it's terrible news that it's about to end. The armies of Good and Evil are amassing. The Four Horsemen are ready to ride. Everything is going according to the Divine Plan...except that someone seems to have misplaced the Antichrist. Can our heroes find him and stop Armageddon before it's too late?

items.title: Archive 81
items.why: An archivist restoring burned tapes uncovers a cult. Found-footage mystery horror.
items.synopsis: An archivist takes a job restoring damaged videotapes and gets pulled into the vortex of a mystery involving the missing director and a demonic cult.

items.title: Doom Patrol
items.why: DC's damaged misfit heroes. Weird, funny, and surprisingly emotional.
items.synopsis: The Doom Patrol’s members each suffered horrible accidents that gave them superhuman abilities — but also left them scarred and disfigured. Traumatized and downtrodden, the team found purpose through The Chief, who brought them together to investigate the weirdest phenomena in existence — and to protect Earth from what they find.

items.title: Creature Commandos
items.why: The first DCU series: Amanda Waller's team of monsters on a suicide mission. From James Gunn, maker of Peacemaker (8.5).
items.synopsis: A group of nonhuman criminals comprised of an anthropomorphic weasel, a robot, the bride of Frankenstein, a radioactive skeleton, and their human leader are tasked with stopping an evil sorceress.

items.title: Batman: Caped Crusader
items.why: Bruce Timm's noir animated Batman. Gotham crime stories in the classic style; you gave The Batman 7.5.
items.synopsis: Welcome to Gotham City, where the corrupt outnumber the good, criminals run rampant and law-abiding citizens live in a constant state of fear. Forged in the fire of tragedy, wealthy socialite Bruce Wayne becomes something both more and less than human—the Batman. His one-man crusade for justice attracts unexpected allies within the GCPD and City Hall, but his heroic actions spawn deadly, unforeseen ramifications.

items.title: Sweet Home
items.why: Residents of an apartment block fight people turning into monsters. Korean creature-survival horror.
items.synopsis: As humans turn into savage monsters and the world plunges into terror, a handful of survivors fight for their lives — and to hold on to their humanity.

items.title: Tokyo Vice
items.why: An American reporter in 1990s Tokyo gets tangled with the yakuza. Michael Mann-produced crime thriller.
items.synopsis: A first-hand account of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police beat following Jake Adelstein, an American journalist who embeds himself into the Tokyo Vice police squad to reveal corruption. Based on Jake Adelstein’s non-fiction book of the same name.

items.title: Luther
items.why: Idris Elba as a brilliant, unstable detective. Gripping British crime thriller.
items.synopsis: John Luther is a brilliant homicide detective with a knack for getting inside the minds of murderers. Unfortunately, his unconventional methods and personal demons put him at odds with his team.

items.title: Yellowjackets
items.why: A girls' soccer team stranded in the wilderness, and the secrets they carry 25 years later. Mystery horror.
items.synopsis: A wildly talented girls' high school soccer team become the unlucky survivors of a plane crash deep in the Canadian wilderness.

items.title: Bosch
items.why: An LAPD homicide detective works cold cases. Grounded, binge-worthy crime procedural.
items.synopsis: Harry Bosch, an LAPD homicide detective, stands trial for the fatal shooting of a serial murder suspect. A cold case involving the remains of a missing boy forces Bosch to confront his past. As daring recruit Julia Brasher catches his eye and departmental politics heat up, Bosch will pursue justice at all costs.

items.title: The Americans
items.why: KGB spies posing as a suburban couple in 1980s DC. Tense spy drama.
items.synopsis: Set during the Cold War period in the 1980s, The Americans is the story of Elizabeth and Philip Jennings, two Soviet KGB officers posing as an American married couple in the suburbs of Washington D.C. and their neighbor, Stan Beeman, an FBI Counterintelligence agent.

items.title: Hellbound
items.why: Angels announce your death, then monsters collect. Korean apocalyptic horror from the Train to Busan director.
items.synopsis: Unearthly beings deliver bloody condemnations, sending individuals to hell and giving rise to a religious group founded on the idea of divine justice.

items.title: Warrior
items.why: A martial-arts prodigy in 1870s San Francisco's tong wars. Based on Bruce Lee's ideas, packed with fights.
items.synopsis: During the Tong Wars in the late 1800s, Ah Sahm, a martial arts prodigy from China, immigrates to San Francisco and becomes a hatchet man for the most powerful tong in Chinatown.

items.title: Succession
items.why: A media mogul's kids fight to take over the empire. Dark comedy with sharp writing.
items.synopsis: Follow the lives of the Roy family as they contemplate their future once their aging father begins to step back from the media and entertainment conglomerate they control.

items.title: The Sandman
items.why: Dream, lord of stories, rebuilds his kingdom after a century in captivity. Gaiman's dark fantasy.
items.synopsis: After years of imprisonment, Morpheus — the King of Dreams — embarks on a journey across worlds to find what was stolen from him and restore his power.

items.title: It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia
items.why: Terrible friends run a terrible bar. Long-running dark comedy, in the Arrested Development (9.6) lane.
items.synopsis: Four egocentric friends run a neighborhood Irish pub in Philadelphia and try to find their way through the adult world of work and relationships. Unfortunately, their warped views and precarious judgments often lead them to trouble, creating a myriad of uncomfortable situations that usually only get worse before they get better.

items.title: Wayward Pines
items.why: A Secret Service agent wakes in a town he can't escape. Twisty M. Night Shyamalan-produced mystery.
items.synopsis: Imagine the perfect American town... beautiful homes, manicured lawns, children playing safely in the streets. Now imagine never being able to leave. You have no communication with the outside world. You think you're going insane. You must be in Wayward Pines.

items.title: Upload
items.why: Dead people live on in a luxury digital afterlife. Sci-fi comedy-mystery from Greg Daniels (The Office).
items.synopsis: After his premature death, a man's consciousness is uploaded into a virtual world. As he gets comfortable with his surroundings, questions about his death arise.

items.title: Mr. & Mrs. Smith
items.why: Two strangers become spy-agency spouses. Donald Glover's smart, funny spin on the movie.
items.synopsis: Meet the Smiths: two lonely strangers, John and Jane, who have given up their lives and identities to be thrown together as partners – both in espionage and in marriage.

items.title: Lockwood & Co.
items.why: Teen agents fight a ghost epidemic in London. Fun, spooky adventure.
items.synopsis: Lucy, a girl with psychic abilities, joins two boys, Anthony and George, at the ghost-hunting agency Lockwood and Co. to fight the deadly spirits plaguing London, doing their best to save the day without any adult supervision.

items.title: Carnival Row
items.why: A detective in a Victorian city of fae refugees. Fantasy noir with Orlando Bloom.
items.synopsis: In a mystical and dark city filled with humans, fairies and other creatures, a police detective investigates a series of gruesome murders leveled against the fairy population. During his investigation, the detective becomes the prime suspect and must find the real killer to clear his name.

items.title: Outer Range
items.why: A rancher finds a mysterious void on his land. Western meets sci-fi mystery with Josh Brolin.
items.synopsis: A rancher fighting for his land and family stumbles upon an unfathomable mystery at the edge of Wyoming’s wilderness, forcing a confrontation with the Unknown in ways both intimate and cosmic in the untamable American West.

items.title: The Night Of
items.why: A student wakes beside a murdered woman with no memory. Gripping crime miniseries.
items.synopsis: After a night of partying with a woman he picked up, a man wakes up to find her stabbed to death and is charged with her murder.

items.title: The White Lotus
items.why: Guests at a luxury resort, and a dead body. Satirical whodunit, one season per resort.
items.synopsis: Follow the exploits of various guests and employees at an exclusive tropical resort over the span of a week as with each passing day, a darker complexity emerges in these picture-perfect travelers, the hotel’s cheerful employees and the idyllic locale itself.

items.title: Vikings
items.why: Since you gave Rome an 11: Ragnar Lothbrok's raids and rise to king. Brutal historical epic with battles and politics.
items.synopsis: The adventures of Ragnar Lothbrok, the greatest hero of his age. The series tells the sagas of Ragnar's band of Viking brothers and his family, as he rises to become King of the Viking tribes. As well as being a fearless warrior, Ragnar embodies the Norse traditions of devotion to the gods. Legend has it that he was a direct descendant of Odin, the god of war and warriors.

schema.rows[].items[].tag: optional; 'explore' marks a deliberate pick outside the usual genres (for discovery). Clients may show a badge or ignore it.

items.title: Parasyte -the maxim-
items.why: Alien parasites hitchhike in human hosts; one boy keeps his. Body-horror action with a sharp philosophical streak.
items.synopsis: A species of parasitic aliens descends on Earth and quickly infiltrates humanity by entering the brains of vulnerable targets; insatiable beings that gain total control of their host and are capable of transforming themselves to feed on unsuspecting prey. High school student Shinichi Izumi falls victim to one of these parasites, but the creature fails to take over his brain and ends up in his right hand.

items.title: Vinland Saga
items.why: A Viking boy's revenge quest becomes something wiser. Peak historical action that earns every quiet beat.
items.synopsis: For a thousand years, the Vikings have made quite a name and reputation for themselves as the strongest families with a thirst for violence. Thorfinn, the son of one of the Vikings' greatest warriors, spends his boyhood in a battlefield enhancing his skills in his adventure to redeem his most-desired revenge after his father was murdered.

items.title: Made in Abyss
items.why: Children descend a beautiful, lethal chasm. Wonder that curdles into genuine dread — Hell's Paradise adjacent.
items.synopsis: Located in the center of a remote island, the Abyss is the last unexplored region, a huge and treacherous fathomless hole inhabited by strange creatures where only the bravest adventurers descend in search of ancient relics. In the upper levels of the Abyss, Riko, a girl who dreams of becoming an explorer, stumbles upon a mysterious little boy.

items.title: Gôruden Kamui
items.why: A brutal survival treasure hunt in Hokkaido after the Russo-Japanese War. Violence and dark comedy like Hell's Paradise (9.5).
items.synopsis: In the early 20th century in Hokkaido, Japan, a treasure hunt between various parties takes place for a hidden stash of gold.

items.title: Hellsing Ultimate
items.why: An unstoppable vampire works for the Protestant church against Nazis and the Vatican. Gloriously excessive gothic action.
items.synopsis: For over a century, the mysterious Hellsing Organization has been secretly protecting the British Empire from the undead. When Sir Integra Hellsing succeeded as the head of the organization, she also inherited the ultimate weapon against these supernatural enemies: Alucard, a rogue vampire possessing mysterious and frightening powers. Now, Hellsing must deal with a more dangerous threat than vampires.

items.title: Dorohedoro
items.why: A lizard-headed amnesiac hunts sorcerers in a filthy city. Weird, funny, and violently inventive.
items.synopsis: Amnesiac Caiman seeks to undo his lizard head curse by killing the sorcerer responsible, with his friend Nikaido's help. In the Hole, that's a threat.

items.title: Ragna Crimson
items.why: A dragon slayer pairs with a genius silver-haired partner. Dark fantasy fights with clean power logic.
items.synopsis: Ragna teams up with the enigmatic Crimson to stand against the dragons menacing the world. Although Crimson's motivations are mysterious, his goal and Ragna's perfectly align, and together they'll vanquish the dragons once and for all.

items.title: Monster
items.why: A surgeon saves a boy who becomes a monster. Slow-burn psychological thriller — Death Note's colder cousin.
items.synopsis: Kenzou Tenma, a Japanese brain surgeon in Germany, finds his life in utter turmoil after getting involved with a psychopath that was once a former patient.

items.title: Tengoku Daimakyo
items.why: Kids leave a walled paradise into a monster-ruined world. Mystery-box dark fantasy that stays unpredictable.
items.synopsis: In the year 2024, the world has collapsed. Grotesque monsters lurk amongst the ruins of Japan, while remaining people scrape together what they can to survive. Kiruko, an odd-job girl in Nakano, accepts a mysterious woman's dying wish to take a boy named Maru to a place called Heaven. Maru is convinced that there will be a boy there who looks exactly like him.

items.title: Devilman Crybaby
items.why: A kind boy fuses with a demon as apocalypse arrives. Short, stylish, and emotionally brutal.
items.synopsis: With demons reawakened and humanity in turmoil, a sensitive demon-boy is led into a brutal, degenerate war against evil by his mysterious friend, Ryo.

items.title: Dororo
items.why: A boy robbed of body parts by demons travels with a cynical swordsman. Tragic dark fantasy, complete in 24.
items.synopsis: During the Warring States period, the young thief Dororo encounters Hyakkimaru, a strange, sightless boy who wields fearsome prosthetics in place of his missing limbs. Parts of Hyakkimaru’s body were traded to a group of 12 demons by his father in exchange for power, but thanks to a kindly medicine man, Hyakkimaru survived his horrifying ordeal. Now he roams the land in search of his missing body, and together he and Dororo will fight to survive in an unforgiving, demon-plagued world.

items.title: Blade of the Immortal
items.why: An immortal swordsman on a bloody redemption path. Gory Edo action — HIDIVE exclusive grit.
items.synopsis: Manji is a crass, violent samurai with a special ability: he cannot die. Cursed with immortality by the nun Yobikuni as punishment for his ruthless deeds, he has grown weary of his ageless life. The only way to lift the curse is to slay 1,000 evil men. So Manji wanders Japan, shedding the blood of the wicked on his quest to finally die.

items.title: Summer Time Rendering
items.why: Time loops and shadow doppelgangers on a rural island. Tight mystery thriller that sticks the ending.
items.synopsis: Shinpei Ajiro travels home to attend the funeral of a childhood friend, and finds the remote island plagued by a sinister, supernatural force.

items.title: Death Note
items.why: A genius student vs a genius detective with a kill notebook. The cat-and-mouse classic — still unmatched.
items.synopsis: Light Yagami is an ace student with great prospects—and he’s bored out of his mind. But all that changes when he finds the Death Note, a notebook dropped by a rogue Shinigami death god. Any human whose name is written in the notebook dies, and Light has vowed to use the power of the Death Note to rid the world of evil. But will Light succeed in his noble goal, or will the Death Note turn him into the very thing he fights against?

items.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion
items.why: Exiled prince gains absolute-command power and wages war on Britannia. Mecha + mind games at full throttle.
items.synopsis: Japan has been invaded and conquered by the Britannian Empire. Japan is now known as Area 11 and its citizens known as Elevens. The Britannian Empire takes away Japan's autonomous power and imposes its rule through the use of Knightmares. The Empire's rule has never faltered, but cracks have begun to show...

items.title: Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works
items.why: Next after Fate/Zero (7.5): the Fifth Holy Grail War from Shirō's route. Servant battles with clearer heart.
items.synopsis:
This story focuses primarily on the heroine Rin Tohsaka. After her father’s death, Rin enters the Holy Grail War as the sole heir to the prestigious Tohsaka Household, with her servant Archer. But, she soon finds out that Shirou Emiya, a boy from her high school has gotten himself involved in the battles and unexpectedly saves him when he is fatally injured. Before long, Rin sets out to strike down the conspiracies surrounding the Holy Grail War along with Shirou and his summoned servant Saber. And so, the story begins to explore the truth behind Shirou’s powers and the nature behind his unyielding will to become a “hero.”

© TYPE-MOON, ufotable, FSNPC

items.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress
items.why: Steam trains vs zombie-like Kabane in an alternate Japan. Fast, stylish action with a strong lead duo.
items.synopsis: In the midst of an industrial revolution, the people of Hinomoto fight hordes of undead creatures, known as Kabane, using powerful armored trains.

items.title: Sword of the Demon Hunter
items.why: Demon-slaying period action with a tragic edge. Fresh HIDIVE/Hulu dark fantasy.
items.synopsis: Jinta journeys through a century-spanning epic, all while questioning why he wields a sword.

items.title: Gachiakuta
items.why: Thrown into an abyss of trash monsters, a boy fights with rule-based power. 2025's breakout dark shonen.
items.synopsis: Accused of murder and thrown into the Pit, a young orphan joins a group of monster fighters with special powers to uncover the truth and seek vengeance.

items.title: Dandadan
items.why: Occult and aliens collide for two teens. Hilarious, scary, and kinetic — modern shonen with bite.
items.synopsis: When Momo and Okarun's beliefs clash, they're thrown into a world of ghosts, aliens and awakened powers.

items.title: Goblin Slayer
items.why: A grim adventurer who only hunts goblins. Brutal dark fantasy in the Hell's Paradise (9.5) lane.
items.synopsis:
"I'm not saving the world. I just kill goblins."

Rumor has it that, in a certain guild in the middle of nowhere, there is an extraordinary man who has climbed all the way to the Silver rank just by killing goblins. At the same guild, a priestess who's just become a new adventurer has formed her first party... and the man who ends up rescuing that party when they get into trouble is none other than the Goblin Slayer.

items.title: Mob Psycho 100
items.why: A middle-school esper just wants a normal life. Hilarious and heartfelt with absurd psychic set pieces.
items.synopsis: Shigeo Kageyama, a.k.a. "Mob," is a boy who has trouble expressing himself, but who happens to be a powerful esper. Mob is determined to live a normal life and keeps his ESP suppressed, but when his emotions surge to a level of 100%, something terrible happens to him! As he's surrounded by false espers, evil spirits, and mysterious organizations, what will Mob think? What choices will he make?

items.title: Steins;Gate
items.why: A self-styled mad scientist stumbles into real time travel. Slow start, all-time payoff.
items.synopsis: A group of friends have customized their microwave so that it can send text messages to the past. As they perform different experiments, an organization named SERN who has been doing their own research on time travel tracks them down and now the characters have to find a way to avoid being captured by them.

items.title: The Promised Neverland
items.why: Orphans uncover why their idyllic home exists. Season 1 is a masterpiece of escape-planning tension.
items.synopsis: Emma, Norman and Ray are the brightest kids at the Grace Field House orphanage. And under the care of the woman they refer to as “Mom,” all the kids have enjoyed a comfortable life. Good food, clean clothes and the perfect environment to learn—what more could an orphan ask for? One day, though, Emma and Norman uncover the dark truth of the outside world they are forbidden from seeing.

items.title: Kaiju No. 8
items.why: A 30-something cleaner becomes a kaiju and infiltrates the Defense Force. Fresh take on the monster-power fantasy.
items.synopsis: A man working a job far removed from his childhood dreams gets wrapped up in an unexpected situation - becoming a monster, he aims once again to fulfill his lifelong dream.

items.title: Shangri-La Frontier
items.why: A gamer who beats broken games takes on a god-tier VR MMO. Clever boss fights Tower of God fans will like.
items.synopsis: High schooler Rakuro loves beating bad games. But can he discover all the secrets hidden in a best-selling VR game?

items.title: Paranoia Agent
items.why: Satoshi Kon's urban legend thriller: a golden bat assailant and a city losing its mind. Short and unforgettable.
items.synopsis: Musashino, Tokyo. An elementary schooler repeatedly attacks people in the streets. Known only to the public as "Lil Slugger", none of the victims can recall the young boy's face and only three distinct details are left in their memories: golden inline skates, a baseball cap, and the weapon: a bent golden baseball bat. Detectives Ikari and Maniwa set out to track down the perpetrator and put an end to his crimes.

items.title: Anazâ
items.why: A cursed class where students die in Final Destination-style accidents. 12-episode mystery horror.
items.synopsis: When Kouichi arrives at his new school, he immediately senses something frightening in the atmosphere of his new class, something that no student wants to talk about and that seems to be related to a mysterious and silent girl.

items.title: High School of the Dead
items.why: Students fight through a sudden zombie apocalypse. Pulpy, gory survival — HIDIVE staple.
items.synopsis: A small group of students at Fujimi High are fighting for their lives after surviving a zombie outbreak. It is up to Takashi to unite the survivors and escape the horrors that surround them. In this new world of the living dead...will they escape?

items.title: Babylon
items.why: A justice official's ideology unleashes societal collapse. Dark political thriller anime — uncommon and sharp.
items.synopsis: Prosecutor Seizaki Zen investigates illegal acts by a pharmaceutical firm, uncovering a conspiracy surrounding the election for Tokyo's new autonomous western zone.

items.title: Psycho-Pass
items.why: Crime coefficient AI judges guilt before the act. Cyberpunk police procedural with real philosophy.
items.synopsis: In the year 2113, people are given brain scans to determine how likely they are to commit a crime. Those who fail are apprehended, or even killed.

items.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
items.why: Start with Phantom Blood/Battle Tendency: bizarre powers, poses, and escalating fights. Unique shonen DNA.
items.synopsis: Follow the intergenerational feud between the Joestar Family and various forces of evil, the most prominent of which is Dio Brando and his followers.

items.title: Helck
items.why: A human hero enters a demon tournament to wipe out humanity — or so it seems. Subversive and funny dark fantasy.
items.synopsis: Three months have passed since the Demon Lord was struck down, and the Demon Realm is holding a tournament to select his replacement. The leading contestant is Helck, a human hero who claims to hate his own kind. Some aren't happy with the idea of a human becoming the next Demon Lord—especially Vermilio the Red. She wants nothing more than to protect demonkind and prove Helck to be their enemy, even if she has to rig the competition to do it!

items.title: Tougen Anki
items.why: A boy learns he's an oni and enters a bloody academy war. New-school action with clear stakes.
items.synopsis: After a Momotaro assassin suddenly kills his adoptive father, Shiki vows to avenge him. But first, he must learn to control his newly awakened Oni blood.

items.title: Ajin
items.why: Immortal Ajin are hunted as resources. Dark sci-fi action with a cold, strategic protagonist.
items.synopsis: 17 years ago, immortals first appeared on the battlefields of Africa. Later, rare, unknown new immortal lifeforms began appearing among humans, and they became known as "Ajin" (demi-humans). Just before summer vacation, a Japanese high school student is instantly killed in a traffic accident on his way home from school. However, he is revived, and a price is placed on his head. Thus begins a boy's life on the run from all of humankind.

items.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica
items.why: Magical girls, then the rug pull. Short, stylish, and devastating — genre deconstruction done right.
items.synopsis: She has a loving family and best friends, laughs and cries from time to time... Madoka Kaname, an eighth grader of Mitakihara middle school, is one of those who lives such a life. One day, she had a very magical encounter. She doesn't know if it happened by chance or by fate yet. This is a fateful encounter that can change her destiny. This is a beginning of the new story of the magical witch girls.

items.title: Dusk Beyond the End of the World
items.why: Post-apocalyptic journey with androids and fading humanity. Moody HIDIVE sci-fi original.
items.synopsis: When tensions around AI spark civil unrest, Akira is caught in the crossfire when he protects his girlfriend from an assassin. Hundreds of years later, he awakens from cryogenic sleep to an unfamiliar world and bonds with the android Yuugure.

items.title: Yofukashi no Uta
items.why: An insomniac teen meets a vampire who shows him the night. Stylish, sensual, surprisingly thoughtful.
items.synopsis: Ko, a human boy, falls in love with Nanakusa, a vampire girl, and wants to become a vampire too, but Nanakusa invites him to her abandoned building just to taste the sweet blood from her neck.

items.title: Ergo Proxy
items.why: A inspector and an immigrant hunt a series of android murders in a dome city. Dense cyberpunk philosophy.
items.synopsis: Thousands of years after Earth’s atmosphere was destroyed, adventure blooms in the strangest of places. The domed city of Romdo is supposed to be perfect, but Re-l Mayer, a young female inspector from the Civilian Intelligence Office, knows better. In this place where humans and robots coexist, she receives a strange message: something is awakening!

items.title: NieR: Automata Ver 1.1a
items.why: Androids fight a long war and question existence. Game adaptation that keeps the melancholy punch.
items.synopsis: Animated adaptation of NieR: Automata (2017), where a long-running war on post-apocalyptic Earth between androids and machines soon unveils the truth of the world.

items.title: Trigun
items.why: Vash the Stampede — a pacifist gunman with a planet-killing legend. Classic western space comedy-drama.
items.synopsis: Trigun takes place in the distant future on a desert planet. Vash the Stampede is a gunfighter with a legend so ruthless he has a $$60,000,000,000 bounty on his head. Entire towns evacuate at the rumor of his arrival. But the real Vash the Stampede, the enigmatic and conflicted lead character, is more heroic, even though he usually acts like a complete idiot.

items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion
items.why: Teens pilot biomechanical gods against Angels. The mecha psychological landmark — watch the series, then EoE.
items.synopsis: At the turn of the century, the Angels returned to Earth, seeking to wipe out humanity in an apocalyptic fury. Devastated, mankind's last remnants moved underground to wait for the day when the Angels would come back to finish the job. Fifteen years later, that day has come... but this time, humanity is ready to fight back with terrifying bio-mechanical weapons known as the Evangelions. Watch as Shinji, Rei, Asuka and the rest of the mysterious shadow agency Nerv battle to save earth from total annihilation.

items.title: Cowboy Bebop
items.why: Bounty hunters in a lived-in solar system. Cool jazz action with a perfect ending.
items.synopsis: In 2071, roughly fifty years after an accident with a hyperspace gateway made the Earth almost uninhabitable, humanity has colonized most of the rocky planets and moons of the Solar System. Amid a rising crime rate, the Inter Solar System Police (ISSP) set up a legalized contract system, in which registered bounty hunters, also referred to as "Cowboys", chase criminals and bring them in alive in return for a reward.

items.title: Pluto
items.why: Urasawa reimagines Astro Boy as a murder mystery among advanced robots. Prestige anime thriller.
items.synopsis: When the world's seven most advanced robots and their human allies are murdered one by one, Inspector Gesicht soon discovers that he's also in danger.

items.title: ERASED
items.why: A man jumps back to childhood to stop a kidnapping timeline. Tight mystery with a ticking clock.
items.synopsis: Satoru Fujinuma is a struggling manga artist who has the ability to turn back time and prevent deaths. When his mother is killed he turns back time to solve the mystery, but ends up back in elementary school, just before the disappearance of his classmate Kayo.

items.title: Mononoke
items.why: A medicine seller exorcises twisted spirits. Stunning stylized horror anthology — not the Ghibli film.
items.synopsis: The Medicine Seller is a deadly and mysterious master of the occult who travels across feudal Japan in search of malevolent spirits called mononoke to slay. When he locates one of these spirits, he cannot simply kill it; he must first learn its Form, its Truth, and its Reason in order to wield the mighty Exorcism Sword and fight against it. He must begin his strange exorcisms with intense psychological analysis and careful investigative work—an extremely dangerous step, as he must first confront and learn about the mononoke before he even has the means to defeat it.

items.title: Dark Gathering
items.why: A boy haunted by spirits is hired by a girl who collects ghosts. Genuinely scary modern HIDIVE horror.
items.synopsis: The story centers on Keitarou Gentouga, who has the ability to be a spirit medium. In junior high school, he got someone else wrapped up in a spirit possession incident, and he has been a shut-in for more than two years. As he reintroduces himself to society as a private tutor, he meets a genius girl named Yayoi Houzuki. Yayoi is instantly able to tell that Keitarou has skill as a spirit medium, and she invites him to go with her to a haunted location. The two then start their journey capturing evil spirits.

items.title: Kengan Ashura
items.why: Corporations settle disputes with underground death matches. Pure fight-tournament momentum.
items.synopsis: Middle manager Kazuo finds himself thrust into underground corporate warfare when assigned to handle a powerful fighter. Their path leads to a tournament where businesses battle for supremacy.

items.title: Ninja Kamui
items.why: A former ninja's family is murdered; revenge follows. John Wick with ninjas, from Adult Swim.
items.synopsis: Former ninja Joe Higan is ambushed by assassins who seek bloody revenge on him and his family for their betrayal, after escaping his clan and fleeing into rural America.

items.title: Lazarus
items.why: Watanabe's new team races to stop a lethal wonder drug. Bebop DNA with a conspiracy clock.
items.synopsis: In 2052, a Nobel Prize-winning neuroscientist develops a drug called Hapna — a cure-all that has the unexpected side-effect of causing death three years later. In response to this threat, a special force of agents—nicknamed "Lazarus"— is assembled to take on the malevolent Skinner.
